description: This file defines a CKEditor dialog plugin for 'select' elements, including functions for managing options within a select dropdown, and dialog UI setup.

methods.name: b
methods.description: Creates and adds an 'OPTION' element to a select element, setting its text and value.

methods.name: c
methods.description: Removes all 'option' children from a select element and resets selection.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Modifies the text and value of a specific option in a select element.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Removes all child elements from a given element.

methods.name: f
methods.description: Moves an option up or down within the options list.

methods.name: g
methods.description: Returns the selected index of a select element.

methods.name: h
methods.description: Sets the selected index of a select element.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Returns the children of a given element.

methods.name: j
methods.description: Retrieves the input element from a given object.
